orders.reason: D6 failure. All four clauses run through the National Security Resources Board (the Committee advises the NSRB; the NSRB Chairman appoints members; the NSRB pays expenses). The claim itself records that Reorganization Plan No. 3 of 1953 (effective 1953-06-12 per the held DMO VII-9 text in the EO 10610 file) reorganized mobilization under ODM and that whether it displaced the NSRB, and with it the Committee, is 'unknown'; the plan text is not held. That is a material later event (and possible earlier end) before the 1953-08-14 supersession, yet unresolved_material_gaps is empty and the whole-order end is described as only an 'upper bound, not a certified end'. Under the brief (first end needing an unheld external instrument -> block; unheld amending text -> FETCH_QUEUE + unresolved_material_gaps) and the producer's own standard for EO 10359, this must be blocked until the plan text is held.

EO 10480 sec. 607(7) (held official FR text) supersedes EO 10324 without qualification; no effective-date wording, so 1953-08-14. Both clauses inventoried. Other-actor leads (EO 10359, 10373, 10377, 10390) amend other sections of EO 10161, not sec. 901. EO 10324 contains no 'Defense Production Administrator' or 'Director of Defense Mobilization' reference (the only DM hit is the FR contents column), so neither EO 10433 sec. 1(a) nor EO 10461 sec. 2(a) reaches it. Savings: sec. 606 keeps actions; sec. 601(e),(k) re-prescribe the two definitions. Note: claim-checker all_checks_passed=false (ACT source is APP custody_record_only; needs an act_overrides record to the held FR text) so it does not count as 'claims_enabled'.

Confirmed: EO 10359 text refers to the Defense Production Administrator; EO 10433 sec. 1(a) (held) amends every such reference in prior orders to the Director of Defense Mobilization, and EO 10461 sec. 2(a) then re-amends DM references, effective on an unheld event (sec. 6). Material later events without attachable evidence ids -> block is correct.

The only clause's first_end.date is 1953-09-14, contradicting the held EO 10480 text (signed 'August 14, 1953', 18 FR 4944), the clause's own mechanism text ('took effect on signing, August 14, 1953'), the OFR note, and the claim's whole_order_end.date 1953-08-14; a clause cannot end a month after the whole order. Separately, even with 1953-08-14 the claim calls its end an 'upper bound': DPA Title VI real-estate-credit functions may not have been continued by the DPA Amendments of 1953 (EO 10467 sec. 1, held, continues delegation orders only for continued functions, effective 1953-07-01), the statute is not held and unresolved_material_gaps is empty, so it should be blocked like EO 10169.

orders.reason: Supersession by EO 10480 sec. 607(11) on 1953-08-14 is correctly read, and EO 10434 (held) is correctly ruled out as a suspension of wage-stabilizing orders that does not touch the alternate-member paragraph. But the claim itself states that the Title IV wage-stabilization functions of the Wage Stabilization Board may not have been continued by the (unheld) DPA Amendments of 1953 (EO 10467 sec. 1, held, continues delegation orders only for continued functions from 1953-07-01), so the 1953-08-14 end is self-described as an 'upper bound, not a certified end' while unresolved_material_gaps is empty. An earlier end resting on unheld statute text -> block per brief; refile when the Amendments are held.

Confirmed: EO 10461 sec. 2(b) names EO 10433 (APP transcription, full) but the held official EO_10461.txt is truncated after sec. 1 ('Continued on p. 3515'), and sec. 6 makes it effective when the first ODM Director under Reorganization Plan No. 3 enters office, a date in no held source. Block correct.

EO 10480 sec. 607(13) supersedes it on 1953-08-14 (held FR text). Inventory override (secs. 1, 2a, 2b, 3) covers all operative text; dropped spans are preamble and the FR contents column. 'Until further order of the President' is an open continuation ended by EO 10480; the dossier 'report_deadline' is a contents-column artefact. EO 10467 already uses 'Director of the Office of Defense Mobilization', so EO 10461 sec. 2(a) does not reach it; no other text names it. Same checker caveat as EO 10324 (APP custody; not all_checks_passed).

EO 13992 sec. 2 (held, signed 2021-01-20, no effective-date wording) revokes it whole. 19/19 clauses. Sec. 2(b) given an own-terms end of 2017-09-30 ('For fiscal year 2017 ... to be finalized this year'); I accept it as a reasoned judgement, noting the fiscal-year end date comes from general law, not a held source, and that it does not change the whole-order end. Leads EO 13777, 13783, 13790, 13817, 13891 only cite it (by-number scan confirms). CFR leads repeat EO 13891's compliance list. No reinstatement by EO 14148/14154/14192.
